narrative.details: Light explodes as you finish the incantation. The sounds of the water drops hitting the flame have died down and your senses are overcome as the corrupt spirits around you are destroyed.
narrative.objectives: Speak to the Minor Manifestation of Water in Silverpine Forest.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thanks to you. Thanks to the shamans.Corruption ebbs but life continues to wane. Up to shamans to protect life.
